assert op.kj('-n','argocd','get','application','forgejo-azure')['metadata']['uid']==app['metadata']['uid']

def patch_uid(ns,kind,name,uid,operations):
    return op.k('-n',ns,'patch',kind,name,'--type=json','-p',json.dumps([{'op':'test','path':'/metadata/uid','value':uid}]+operations))

def delete_owned(name,uid):
    p=op.kj('-n','forgejo','get','pod',name)
    assert p['metadata']['uid']==uid and p['metadata']['labels'].get('p7.campaign')==op.M['campaign']
    op.k('-n','forgejo','delete','pod',name,'--wait=true','--timeout=180s',timeout=190)

def resume():
    errors=[]
    steps=[('replicas',lambda:patch_uid('forgejo','deployment','forgejo',deployment['metadata']['uid'],[{'op':'replace','path':'/spec/replicas','value':deployment['spec']['replicas']}])),
           ('service',lambda:patch_uid('forgejo','service','forgejo-http',service['metadata']['uid'],[{'op':'replace','path':'/spec/selector','value':service['spec']['selector']}])),
           ('argo',lambda:patch_uid('argocd','application','forgejo-azure',app['metadata']['uid'],[{'op':'replace','path':'/spec/syncPolicy','value':app['spec']['syncPolicy']}]))]
    for name,f in steps:
        try:f()
        except Exception:errors.append(name)
    op.k('-n','forgejo','rollout','status','deployment/forgejo','--timeout=300s',timeout=310)
    deadline=time.monotonic()+180

        current=op.kj('-n','argocd','get','application','forgejo-azure')

            assert current['spec']['syncPolicy']==app['spec']['syncPolicy'] and current['spec']['sources']==app['spec']['sources']
            break

    else:raise RuntimeError('stable Argo readiness did not return')
    op.run(['curl','-q','--noproxy','*','--proto','=https','--resolve',op.M['hostname']+':443:'+op.M['ingress_ip'],'--max-time','15','--fail','--silent','https://'+op.M['hostname']+'/api/healthz'])
    current=op.kj('-n','forgejo','get','deployment','forgejo')

    assert op.kj('-n','forgejo','get','service','forgejo-http')['spec']==service['spec']
    assert op.kj('-n','forgejo','get','pvc','forgejo-data')['metadata']['uid']==op.M['stable_pvc_uid']
    assert not errors
    elapsed=time.monotonic()-maintenance_start if maintenance_start else 0
    op.M.setdefault('maintenance_windows',[]).append({'start_utc':op.M.get('maintenance_start_utc'),'end_utc':op.now(),'elapsed_seconds':elapsed})
    op.M['stable_resumed']=True;op.metadata()

    op.phase('stable_resumed_after_checkpoint',success=True,maintenance_seconds=elapsed)

try:
    patch_uid('argocd','application','forgejo-azure',app['metadata']['uid'],[{'op':'add','path':'/spec/syncPolicy/automated/enabled','value':False}])
    op.phase('stable_argo_paused',success=True)
    maintenance_start=time.monotonic();op.M['maintenance_start_utc']=op.now();op.metadata()
    patch_uid('forgejo','service','forgejo-http',service['metadata']['uid'],[{'op':'replace','path':'/spec/selector','value':{'p7-maintenance':op.M['campaign']}}])
    for i in range(30):
        slices=op.kj('-n','forgejo','get','endpointslices','-l','kubernetes.io/service-name=forgejo-http')
        if not any(x.get('endpoints') for x in slices['items']):break
        time.sleep(1)
    else:raise RuntimeError('public writer route not quiesced')

    op.run(['timeout','-k','5s','150s','kubectl','--request-timeout=20s','-n','forgejo','exec',op.M['stable_pod'],'-c','forgejo','--','forgejo','manager','flush-queues','--config','/data/gitea/conf/app.ini','--timeout','2m'],timeout=160,label='stable-queue-flush')

    patch_uid('forgejo','deployment','forgejo',deployment['metadata']['uid'],[{'op':'replace','path':'/spec/replicas','value':0}])
    op.k('-n','forgejo','wait','pod/'+op.M['stable_pod'],'--for=delete','--timeout=180s',timeout=190)
    assert not op.kj('-n','forgejo','get','pods','-l','app.kubernetes.io/name=forgejo')['items']
    assert op.sql("SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname='forgejo';",admin=True).strip()=='0'

    source_pod=json.loads((op.P/'preflight-pods.json').read_text())['items']
    source_pod=next(p for p in source_pod if p['metadata']['uid']==op.M['stable_pod_uid'])
    helper=a.render(v)['checkpoint-helper.json'];helper['spec']['nodeName']=source_pod['spec']['nodeName']
    op.k('apply','-f','-',input=json.dumps(helper))
    helper_uid=op.kj('-n','forgejo','get','pod','p7-checkpoint-helper')['metadata']['uid']
    op.M['source_helper_uid']=helper_uid;op.metadata()
    op.k('-n','forgejo','wait','pod/p7-checkpoint-helper','--for=condition=Ready','--timeout=180s',timeout=190)
    admitted=op.kj('get','pods','-A','-l','p7.campaign='+op.M['campaign']);op.save('checkpoint-admission.json',a.admission(v,admitted))
    commands=[('database.dump',['kubectl','--request-timeout=20s','-n','forgejo','exec','p7-checkpoint-db','--','pg_dump','-Fc','--no-owner']),('application-data.tar',['kubectl','--request-timeout=20s','-n','forgejo','exec','p7-checkpoint-helper','-c','helper','--','tar','-C','/data','-cf','-','.'])]
    for name,args in commands:

        assert r.returncode==0,name+' backup failed'

    doctor=json.loads((op.E/'doctor-source.json').read_text())
    image=next(c['image'] for c in source_pod['spec']['containers'] if c['name']=='forgejo')
